summary: A parent at {place} has to carry used hygiene waste out of the restroom to find a bin.
realLife: A Seattle park visitor described that problem, and auditors found outdoor bins but no indoor bin in most restrooms they visited.
gates: A resident account and a facility inspection locating its bins.
weights: A family visit or a long walk to the outdoor bin makes the placement more visible.
inGame: needs: bin location, inspection note, visitor request and assigned collection route.

turns.what: The manager approves a trial inside the facility.
turns.pulledBy: The crew can add a bin to its collection route.
turns.writesBack: Add the pickup to the route sheet.

turns.what: The manager asks for a collection plan first.
turns.pulledBy: The proposed pickup has no assigned crew.
